hypothesis: Hormone response requires catalysis, not the PPAT interface
scientific_value: Highest, conditional on a new context-specific causal result
feasibility: Substantial cell/genetic/engagement work; stocks not checked
evaluation_type: Prospectively locked mechanistic validation after independent pilot
primary_readout: Hormone-induced nuclear ATP time-course summary in T47D; analysis window fixed using source protocol/pilot before validation
prediction: WT and qualified Y74E restore the response after NUDT5 depletion; qualified E112Q does not
falsifier: E112Q restores the response despite verified loss of both relevant catalytic reactions; or Y74E fails despite appropriate catalytic/localization qualification
inconclusive_if: No depletion phenotype, failed WT rescue, unstable/mislocalized mutant, residual catalysis, reporter artifact or wide intervals
controls: Vehicle/no hormone; empty/WT/E112Q/Y74E rescues; independent depletion reagents; TH5427/MRK-952; protein abundance; reporter-only and toxicity checks
go_no_go: Advance only if rescue panel qualifies and the locked contrast is resolved; otherwise narrow or stop

scientific_value: Highest if a within-model context interaction is established
feasibility: Requires demonstrated purine-stress competence in the same intended cell model
evaluation_type: Prospectively locked paired-context mechanism; HAP1 replication is QC only
primary_readout: Prespecified genotype-by-context interaction using endpoint-appropriate models; do not numerically pool ATP and viability scales

hypothesis: Extra compound-9 biology can be attributed to NUDT14
scientific_value: Mechanistic attribution branch, not assumed consequence of dual binding
feasibility: Requires NUDT14 engagement and depletion/rescue platform
evaluation_type: Prospective conditional branch after cellular-window qualification

prediction: Additional effect depends on NUDT14 and returns with NUDT14 WT rescue
